app.name: Main App
app.summary:
The top level application route layer for the site. It stitches together page rendering, metadata, and the entry points that start scans or open a place.

Implements Home and RootLayout, plus the scan entry actions and page level metadata and viewport settings.

Server and client rendered app routes.

Uses the UI toolkit, place data, and scan logic. The scan flow component set drives its interactive screens.
app.role: Handles the home page and root layout.

components components/ui.name: UI Toolkit
components components/ui.summary:
A design system style component library plus provider code. It centralizes the buttons, dialogs, sidebar layout, toast plumbing, and other primitives used across the app.

Exports ThemeProvider, Button, Sidebar, toast, form, dialog, and many other primitives and helpers.

Pure component library with no runtime of its own.

Builds on the hooks and class utility modules. The app shell consumes it, and the hooks module depends on it.
components components/ui.role: Handles reusable UI primitives and shared shell state.

hooks.name: React Hooks
hooks.summary:
A small browser side hooks package. It wraps mutable UI behavior behind React hooks so components can consume toast state and screen size without owning the plumbing.

Implements the toast queue and reducer plus useToast, and the useIsMobile breakpoint listener.

Runs in the browser as React hooks.

Builds on the UI toolkit. The toolkit uses these hooks for toast and responsive behavior.
hooks.role: Handles toast state and mobile detection hooks.

lib.name: Shared Utils
lib.summary:
A tiny shared utility module. It exists to combine class names in a predictable way for component code.

Exports cn from lib/utils.ts.

Pure library with no runtime of its own.

Used by the UI toolkit for styling.

src/components.name: Panorama Viewer
src/components.summary:
A set of feature components for the interactive scanning experience. It covers the exploratory view, capture controls, panorama viewing, place picking, and reviewing generated scans.

Defines Explore, Capture, ScanReview, PanoramaViewer, PlacePicker, Splash, and their feature specific constants and actions.

Client components rendered in the browser.

Builds on place data and scan logic. The app shell renders these screens, and the scan API and data modules feed them.
src/components.role: Handles exploration, capture, and scan review screens.

src/lib.name: Game Formatting Utils
src/lib.summary:
A domain logic library. It keeps the app specific rules for paths, stored scans, geospatial calculations, history, motion, stitching, and prompt preparation.

Defines scan storage helpers, distance and bearing math, nearby selection, history types, and scan image path utilities.

Pure library with no runtime of its own.

Builds on place data. The app shell, scan API, and capture flow all use it.
src/lib.role: Handles scan storage, geometry, and prompt helpers.

src/data.name: Places Catalog
src/data.summary:
A static content module. It models places and the small tidbits attached to them so the rest of the app can refer to them consistently.

Exports TidbitKind, Tidbit, Place, and the places collection.

Static data loaded at build or import time.

Used by the app shell, scan API, capture flow, and scan logic.

app/api.name: Generate API
app/api.summary:
A server route that accepts POST requests and returns generated output.

Sets runtime limits, constrains years with MIN_YEAR and MAX_YEAR, and builds the prompt in route POST.

Serverless route executed per request.

Stands alone as the app's generation endpoint.

folder:app/api.name: Generate API
folder:app/api.summary:
The backend HTTP layer for scan related operations. It exposes route handlers that turn app requests into generated responses or stored scan lookups.

Implements app/api/generate, app/api/scans, and app/api/scans/image with year, radius, and result limits.

Serverless route handlers per request.

Uses place data and scan logic. The app shell and capture flow depend on these endpoints.
folder:app/api.role: Handles scan generation and scan lookup requests.
